description: WindNinja is the US Forest Service's diagnostic wind model for wildland-fire applications. It builds a three-dimensional mesh and adjusts an initial wind field for terrain using mass conservation, with optional momentum conservation and thermal parameterisations. Inputs are terrain and an estimated initial wind field; outputs are spatial wind fields for the configured area. Geographic coverage is set by the input terrain. The federal source is free and identified as public domain in the repository licence. A limitation is that the model assumes steady conditions and does not represent moisture, latent heat or all complex large-scale flows. The quality of the initial wind estimate remains important. WindNinja can provide wind inputs for wildfire exposure and emergency-response simulations around infrastructure. ERA5 (data-era5-reanalysis) is related weather context, not an automatically validated forcing choice. Public documentation and development papers were inspected; no forecast, terrain dataset or model execution was obtained.
